requirements.desc: `parseDirectives` shall accept `format: "table"` and `format: "list"` on data directives and retain the value for directive expansion.
requirements.note: R1: parser accepts table and list format options for data directives

requirements.desc: `format` shall be treated as parser-owned and shall not appear in the params object passed to DataSource resolver methods.
requirements.note: R2: format is not forwarded to DataSource resolver params

requirements.desc: A data directive with omitted `format` or `format: "table"` shall render exactly the same Markdown table output as the current `Table.toMarkdown()` path.
requirements.note: R3: omitted and explicit table format render the existing markdown table

requirements.desc: A data directive with `format: "list"` and a resolved two-column `Table` shall render one Markdown bullet per row in the exact form `- first-column: second-column`.
requirements.note: R4: list format renders two-column tables as markdown bullet rows

requirements.desc: `format: "list"` shall fail with an explicit error when the resolved value is not a `Table` or when the `Table` has any column count other than two.
requirements.note: R5: list format rejects non-Table renderables and non-two-column tables

requirements.desc: Any `format` value other than `table` or `list` shall fail with an explicit error that names the unsupported value.
requirements.note: R6: unsupported format values throw an explicit error naming the value

requirements.desc: The same format behavior shall apply to all existing `resolveDataDirectives` callers, including docs data population, README generation, and AGENTS generation.
requirements.note: R7: resolveDataDirectives applies the same format behavior at the shared expansion boundary

requirements.desc: Automated tests shall cover parser-owned format filtering, unchanged default table rendering, explicit table format rendering, two-column list rendering, non-Table list error, non-two-column list error, and unsupported format value error.
requirements.note: R8: this spec-local test file declares coverage for every testable requirement
